title: Stuff Smith's band at the Hotel Vendome in Buffalo
summary: Luke Stewart, Jonah Jones and Tom played at the Hotel Vendome in Buffalo in a band with Stuff Smith, whose violin and singing she admired. She also praises violinist Ginger Smock.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: When you went to see Luke and Margaret Stewart, then Luke was playing with Jonah and Dicky and Tom. They were playing in a club in Buffalo. What was the name of the Club?
The Vendome, a hotel.
Oh, it was a hotel?
Yeah. They played in the hotel.
Wasn't Stuff in that band? Stuff Smith?
Yeah.

Was he sounding as good as ever?
Sounding good, I've never heard him sound bad. He was the greatest. He was something else.
Well, you must have been an inspiration to him. Couldn't he sing?
Yeah, he could sing.
He always sang.
Yeah.
He had a perfect pitch, didn't he?
Yeah. But I always enjoyed his violin. You know you didn't hear people play violin like that.
No.
And I know of a girl that use to play like lightening.
Really?
She's in Las Vegas right now. Her name is Ginger Smock.
Really, how do you spell Smock?
S-M-O-C-K.
Fancy that.
